info.description:
Feature flags and remote settings for the ProductCraft platform. Manage projects, environments, configs, flags, targeting rules and segments here; SDKs download a compact config per environment and evaluate flags locally, so user attributes never leave your app.

## Rate limits

Every `/v1` route is limited per client IP to 20 requests per second and 600 per minute. Each response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit-short`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-short`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-short` (the one-second window) and the same three with `-long` (the one-minute window). Over either limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

Flags counts these limits per credential (API key or session), not per IP, and allows at most 120 writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) a minute within them.

get.description: The config JSON (schema 1) every SDK downloads and evaluates locally: no user data is sent. Authenticated by the SDK key in the path, which can read only this config in this environment; no API key or session. Poll with `If-None-Match` (the last `ETag`) and get 304 while nothing changed; changes show within about 5 seconds. Responses are `br`, `gzip` or identity per `Accept-Encoding`, CORS `*` without credentials. Limits: 20 requests per second per (SDK key, client IP) and 20 per client IP; a matching 304 is never refused for the key's sake; unknown keys 2 per second per IP. If the database is unreachable the API keeps serving its last good copy with `X-PC-Config-Stale: 1` for up to 24 hours. `HEAD` answers the same headers without the body.
